ncaaf.note: Ranked by opponent-adjusted scoring margin, points per game better than an average team against an average opponent, solved from our own results. Last season carries forward as the preseason prior by how much of its production each team actually returns — from 0.39 for a team keeping 15% of its yards to 0.77 for one keeping 85% — and every result since moves it. Strength of schedule is solved alongside it and travels with each row.. Ranked teams average 0.0 game(s) this season, so this is mostly what carried over rather than current form.

user_picks.note: Predictions only — no stake, price or balance is published. The model's figure is the one frozen an hour before kickoff, not a rating computed afterwards.

upset_of_the_week.basis: largest model-minus-market gap on a side the market has as an underdog
upset_of_the_week.caveat: Editorial, not advice. This is the model's most contrarian call of the week, and disagreement of this kind has historically predicted WORSE results on our graded college samples, not better. Publish it as something to watch and grade afterwards, never as a recommended bet.

publication.reason: Live shadow forecasts. Not promoted out of shadow status and not frozen pregame, so they carry no official-pick receipt.

edge_warning: Model-minus-market disagreement is reported, not endorsed. On this engine's graded college samples a larger gap has predicted worse results, not better — the sign is inverted. Do not rank, filter or stake on edge_points.
